items.headline: EnergyCo opens consultation on the South West REZ $60m community benefit fund
items.summary: EnergyCo has launched consultation on how to design and deliver the South West REZ Community and Employment Benefit Program, an initial $60 million fund financed by access fees from the four developers connecting to the zone (Bullawah Wind Farm, Dinawan Energy Hub, Pottinger Energy Park and Yanco Delta Wind Farm). Communities, councils and First Nations groups can give feedback through July and August via an online survey, a noon webinar on 3 August, and drop-in sessions at Jerilderie and Coleambally on 12 August and Darlington Point on 20 August, with the funding area widened to include supportive towns just outside the REZ boundary.
items.so_what: This is a positive social-licence lever for EnergyCo in the South West, pairing the recently sealed 3.56GW Transgrid transmission deed with a visible, developer-funded local dividend just as landholder sentiment hardens on the New England front; how the design consultation and drop-in turnout land will shape whether the fund builds genuine goodwill or is read as a token. Worth tracking submission volume, First Nations engagement and any contest over how benefits are distributed inside versus outside the zone boundary, since a poorly received program could blunt the intended community-benefit signal.
